l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s1.r.d: Simba rema-constant term rinodzika sezvo x ichikura.

l-m-h2-b0d02-08.material: Mhinduro inowana inverse ye y=3ˣ+1. (1) 3ˣ=y−1 (2) x=log₃y−1 (3) Chinjana x ne y kuti uwane y=log₃x−1 (4) Domain i x>0
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s1.r.a: Kubvisa 1 kumativi ose kunopa 3ˣ=y−1, saka yakarurama.
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s1.r.c: Iyi inzira yekuwana inverse function, saka yakarurama.
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s1.r.d: Kukanganisa kwechirevo chepamberi kwakatakurwa. Haisi nzvimbo yekutanga yakakanganisa.
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s1.explain: Kubva ku3ˣ=y−1, x=log₃(y−1). Inverse function i y=log₃(x−1), uye domain i x>1.
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s2.model.0: Kutora logarithm ye3ˣ=y−1, argument yose i y−1, saka x=log₃(y−1). Inverse function i y=log₃(x−1).
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s2.model.1: Sezvo y−1 iri chimwe chose chinova pooro ye3, 1 haigoni kutorwa kunze kwelogarithm, uye inofanira kunyorwa x=log₃(y−1).

l-m-h2-b0d02-18.s.s1.explain: Kukosha kwevertex −1 kweparabola inovhurika kumusoro ndiko kudiki. 3 pa t=−1 ndiko kukura kukuru.

l-m-h2-b0d02-34.title: Humbowo hweinduction hwe"n²+n isina kuenzana": chii chakashaikwa?
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.goal: Teverera matanho ehumbowo hweinduction hwekuti n²+n inogara isina kuenzana (nhevedzano yechikonzero nemhedzisiro), tsvaga kwakatanga kukanganisa, uye ugadzirise.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.material: Humbowo hwe "n²+n haina kuenzana kune nhamba yechisikigo n yose". (1) Fungidzira k²+k isina kuenzana kana n=k (2) (k+1)²+(k+1)=(k²+k)+2(k+1) (3) isina kuenzana+yakaenzana=isina kuenzana, saka inoshandawo kune n=k+1 (4) Inoshanda kune nhamba yechisikigo n yose
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.o.a: (1) Pakafungidzirwa kuti chirevo chinoshanda kune n=k
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.r.a: Uku ndiko kufungidzira kunoitwa mudanho reinduction, saka hakuna dambudziko.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.r.b: Kuwedzera kunopa expression imwe chete, saka yakarurama.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.o.d: (4) Pakapedzwa kuti inoshanda kune dzose pasina kutarisa n=1
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.explain: Danho rekutanga n=1 rashaikwa. 1²+1=2 yakaenzana, uye chaizvo n²+n inogara yakaenzana.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s2.model.0: Ine danho reinduction chete uye haitarise chiitiko n=1, saka humbowo hahushande. 1²+1=2 yakaenzana, saka chirevo chenhema.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s2.model.1: Pasina danho rekutanga hapana poinzi yekutangira, saka mhedzisiro ye (4) haigone kuwanikwa, uye n²+n=n(n+1) inogara yakaenzana, saka chirevo pachacho chakanganisa.

l-m-h2-b0d03-05.title: Kudzima kana denominator iri sikweya: yakaenda zvisina kunaka kupi?
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.goal: Teverera matanho egadziriso inowana lim (x²−1)/(x−1)² (x→1) (nhevedzano yechikonzero nemhedzisiro), tsvaga kwakatanga kukanganisa, uye ugadzirise.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.material: Gadziriso: ① x²−1=(x−1)(x+1) ② Kudzima nedenominator (x−1)² kunosiya x+1 chete ③ Kana x→1, x+1→2 ④ Muganho i 2.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s1.r.c: Kuverenga uku kwakarurama, asi danho rakapfuura rakanga ratokanganisa.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s1.r.d: Mhedzisiro yakanganisa nekuda kwe ②. Hapasi pakatanga kukanganisa.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s2.model.0: (x−1)² inogona kudzimwa ne (x−1) kamwe chete, ichisiya (x+1)/(x−1), saka ② yakanganisa.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s2.model.1: Nekuti (x−1) inosara mudenominator, mutengo unokura kana kudzika usina muganho kana x→1, saka hapana muganho. ②, yakatora kudzima sekwapera, ndiko kukanganisa kwekutanga.

l-m-h2-b0d03-11.title: Kukosha kwakawanikwa netsanangudzo yederivative: mutsara upi ndiwo kukanganisa kwekutanga?
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.goal: Teverera matanho emhinduro inowana f'(2) ye f(x)=x²+3x uchishandisa tsanangudzo (nzira yechikonzero nemhedzisiro), uone panotanga kukanganisa, uye urikururire.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.material: f(x)=x²+3x. Mhinduro: ① f(2)=10 ② f(2+h)=4+h²+6+3h ③ (f(2+h)−f(2))/h=(h²+3h)/h=h+3 ④ Kana h→0, f'(2)=3.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s1.r.c: Tichipiwa mhedzisiro ye②, kuverenga uku kwakarurama. Nzvimbo yakakanganisa pakutanga i②.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s1.r.d: Mhedziso yakakanganisa, asi chikonzero chiri mudanho repamberi.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s1.explain: (2+h)²=4+4h+h². Izwi repakati 4h rakasiiwa, saka 3 yakabuda panzvimbo ye f'(2)=7.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s2.model.0: (2+h)² yakanyorwa se4+h², saka 4h yakasiiwa; ② ndiko kukanganisa kwekutanga, uye kana ikaitwa zvakarurama i(7h+h²)/h→7.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s2.model.1: Fomula yekuwanza (2+h)²=4+4h+h² haina kutevedzerwa, saka yakakanganisa pa②, uye inofanira kururamiswa kuita f'(2)=7.

l-m-h2-b0d03-26.material: Mhinduro yeintegral yakatarwa ye |x| kubva pa −1 kusvika pa 1: ① |x| ndi −x kana x<0 uye x kana x≥0 ② Saka bvisa |x| uise x uye uite integral yose pamwe chete ③ Integral yakatarwa ye x ndi [x²/2]=0 ④ Saka kukosha ndi 0.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.o.b: ② Bvisa |x| uise x uye uite integral yose pamwe chete
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.o.c: ③ Integral yakatarwa ye x ndi 0
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.r.c: Kuverenga uku pachako ndekwechokwadi. Dambudziko ndechirevo chakanyorwa zvisizvo.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.r.d: Mhedziso isiri yechokwadi inobva ku ②.

l-m-h2-b0d04-25.s.s1.explain: G(1) iconstant, saka derivative yayo i 0. g'(x)=G'(x)=x²+2x, uye g'(2)=8.
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.s.s2.model.0: G(1) iconstant isina hukama ne x, saka derivative yayo i 0. Mu ② hatifaniri kubvisa G'(1), saka g'(x)=x²+2x.

l-m-h2-b0d05-23.title: Coefficient ye x² ye (2x+1)⁴, yakaenda zvisina kunaka kupi?
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.goal: Teverera gadziriso, kana cheni yechikonzero nemhedzisiro, ye coefficient ye x² mu (2x+1)⁴, danho nedanho. Tsvaga nzvimbo yekutanga yakaenda zvisina kunaka uye uigadzirise.
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.material: Iyi igadziriso ye coefficient ye x² mu (2x+1)⁴. Danho 1: mutsara wakajairika i 4Cr·2·xʳ·1^(4-r). Danho 2: kune x², r=2. Danho 3: coefficient i 4C2×2=12.
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.s.s1.r.a: Mhinduro yakarurama i 24, saka 12 haina kururama.
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.s.s1.r.c: Kuti uwane x², r=2 mu xʳ, saka izvi zvakarurama.
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.s.s1.r.d: Kushandisa 4C2=6 kwakarurama. Kukanganisa kwekutanga kuri mudanho rakapfuura.
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.s.s1.explain: Sezvo (2x)ʳ=2ʳxʳ, mutsara wakajairika i 4Cr·2ʳ·xʳ. Ne r=2 i 6×4=24.
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.s.s2.model.0: Mu Danho 1, (2x)ʳ yakanyorwa se 2xʳ, ichisiya simba rechi r re 2. Sezvo 2²=4, coefficient inofanira kugadziriswa kuva 6×4=24.
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.s.s2.model.1: Sezvo 2x ichiwanzwa ka r, 2 inowanzwawo ka r, saka mutsara wakajairika i 4Cr·2ʳxʳ, uye kana r=2 i 6×4=24.

l-m-h2-b0d06-21.material: Random variable X inotora mitengo 1, 2, 3 nemikana 1/2, 1/3, a nenhevedzano iyoyo. Iyi mhinduro inowana variance. Danho 1: mikana inowedzera kusvika ku1, saka a=1/6. Danho 2: E(X)=1×1/2+2×1/3+3×1/6=5/3. Danho 3: E(X²)=10/3, saka V(X)=10/3-5/3=5/3.

l-m-h2-b0d06-21.s.s1.explain: V(X)=E(X²)-{E(X)}². Unofanira kuita sikweya E(X) uye kuverenga 10/3-25/9=5/9.
l-m-h2-b0d06-21.s.s2.model.0: Mudanho 3, E(X) inofanira kuitwa sikweya, kwete kubviswa sezvayakaita, saka inofanira kugadziriswa kuita V(X)=10/3-(5/3)²=10/3-25/9=5/9.
l-m-h2-b0d06-21.s.s2.model.1: Variance ndiyo mean yemasikweya kubvisa sikweya yemean, saka kushandisa {E(X)}²=25/9 kunopa 30/9-25/9=5/9.

l-m-h2-b0d04-16.material: f'(3) imuganho we (f(3+h)−f(3))/h kana h→0. Rega x=3+h uye ushandise variable x kuinyora zvakare seexpression ine zvinoreva zvakafanana.
l-m-h2-b0d04-16.s.s1.r.a: Kana f yakaenderera, inova 0, saka haisi rate yekuchinja.
l-m-h2-b0d04-16.s.s1.r.b: Chikamu chinobvisa f(3) nechikamu chinogovanisa ne x−3 zvashaikwa.

l-m-h2-b0d04-16.s.s1.explain: Kana x=3+h, h=x−3, uye h→0 zvinoreva x→3. Saka muganho we (f(x)−f(3))/(x−3) i f'(3).
